I checked both build commits (`ccf9251` and `374e063`) against the plan and the triage's five acceptance criteria, and changed nothing:
- **Planned files:** all five are handled: `src/game.js`, `src/theme.js`, `src/render.js`, `src/main.js` and `test/range-preview.test.js`. No path outside the signed `touches:` list was changed.
- **Acceptance criteria:** each one has a test, and every check of an empty case sits beside a real value. "No ring on the path" is checked as 0 ring strokes in the same assertion that expects 1 on grass. "Nothing returned" is checked as one exact match against `[null, null, null]`. If the picked kind or the placed-tower lookup were dropped, a test would fail.
- **Comments and messages:** they cite `design/screens.html:204`, and the ring is drawn as that line specifies (opaque `#f2c14e`, 1.5px, dashed 6/6, fill at 0.07).
- **Imports:** `render.js` now imports from `game.js`; `game.js` imports nothing from `render.js`, so there is no circular import.
- **Weak point, left as is:** the "no dash leaks" check in `test/range-preview.test.js` would still pass if the `setLineDash([])` line in `src/render.js` were removed, because `restore()` already resets the dash. It only fails if the save/restore pair is removed. That line is harmless and the plan asked for it, so I left it.

GATES green: `node --test` on `test/range-preview.test.js`, `test/game.test.js`, `test/render.test.js` and `test/brazier.test.js` passed 38 of 38, and the tree is committed and clean. This clone has no Makefile, so `make check-build` could not be run.
